title: Malmgren tweet on Bluegill tests and JFK Los Alamos visit

tellings.quote: tweeted am now reconstructing my personal interactions with Los Alamos Lawrence G bluegill ICBM interception tests 1961 62 and JFK visit to Los alos November 1962

plain: Jesse Michels reads out a tweet by a former senior government insider named Harold Malmgren, who wrote that he was "now reconstructing my personal interactions" with Los Alamos, the 1961 to 1962 Bluegill tests, which he describes as tests of intercepting intercontinental ballistic missiles, and John F. Kennedy's visit to Los Alamos in November 1962. Michels brings it up on an episode about UFOs seen over nuclear bases, as a hint that Malmgren saw something tied to those tests that he is only now writing down.
